topic.source_contract: drought status, company plan, triggers, demand forecast, restrictions, environmental permits, emergency measures, efficiency, recovery and actual supply evidence

scope_guards: A drought plan is not treated as a current drought declaration.
A dry-weather trigger is not treated as an implemented restriction.
A temporary use ban is not treated as a drought permit or order.
A drought permit application is not treated as approval.
A water-efficiency target is not treated as measured demand reduction.
Strategic resource availability is not treated as local connection capacity.
End of restrictions is not treated as full environmental recovery.
No score or promotion is written without exact zone, trigger, measures, permits, demand, supply and recovery evidence.
row_checks: Correct undertaker and supply zone required
Current normal, prolonged dry weather or drought status required
Reservoir, groundwater, river and demand indicators required
Defined control-curve and action triggers required
Current household and non-household demand required
Current leakage baseline and actions required
Metering and consumption reduction measures required
Legal scope, dates and exemptions required
Operational intercompany or interzone transfers required
Protected sites and flow impacts required
Trigger exit and source recovery required
Measured continuity, pressure and quality required
Map, policy or strategy alone is not exact-site delivery
Application or proposal is not approval
Funding announcement is not completed delivery
Current operational use or service required
